== Biography ==
John was born in 1796. He was the son of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosana Barclay]].  He passed away in 1859. 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''John Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.
